CustomObject.description: Names the survivors of a Salesforce merge that could not queue its own tidy-up: a merge inside a Queueable job, or in a transaction with no queueable job left. Published after commit, up to 200 identifiers per list, and its subscriber queues the tidy-up in a fresh transaction (rule PEOPLE-15, ADR-0118).
CustomObject.label: Merge Settlement Ready
